description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerGroup model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for managing customer groups, including CRUD operations, descriptions handling, and related database interactions within the admin module.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Model class for managing customer groups in the admin section of Opencart, extending the core Model class and providing methods for CRUD operations, description management, and related database handling.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Creates a new customer group record in the database, including its descriptions, and returns the new customer group ID.

methods.name: editCustomerGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing customer group record and its descriptions based on the provided ID and data.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroup
methods.description: Deletes a customer group and its associated descriptions, discounts, rewards, and tax rate associations from the database.

methods.name: getCustomerGroup
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific customer group, including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of customer groups, optionally filtered, sorted, and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer groups, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a new description record for a customer group in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all description records for a specific customer group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all customer group descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches the description record for a customer group in a specified language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific customer group, indexed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all customer group descriptions for a particular language.
